name: Total cholesterol
summary: Total cholesterol is all the cholesterol in your blood, including LDL and HDL. On its own it says less than the parts that make it up.

high.meaning: A high total cholesterol is often driven by high LDL, but can also come from high HDL. Look at the separate values.

low.meaning: A low total cholesterol is generally not a concern.

biologicalVariation.population: US teens and adults aged 16–69 (NHANES 1999–2002), two samples about 19 days apart; the lab's own imprecision removed

source.title: Biological variation of laboratory analytes based on the 1999-2002 National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey.

sources.title: 2019 ESC/EAS Guidelines for the management of dyslipidaemias: lipid modification to reduce cardiovascular risk
